summary: Part 1 of 3 of the Revibe video "1.2 Onboarding App _ Fulfillment (Seller)" (00:00-04:19). The trainer (Pierre) moves a newly accepted seller from profile approval into the Quality screening stage: he shows the seller's profile in the Seller Onboarding App, copies the Fulfillment App link from the profile, tours the Fulfillment App's SKUs available list (sort, columns, price and quantity meaning), picks one example SKU (010109-060101, Smart Life, Buybox 598, 155 recommended), and walks through creating a shipment with one request line (quantity sent 10, price 597), then saves. Screen data is a snapshot from 8 August 2025 (Created at 08/08/2025 on the request form). All 40 frames were opened.

facts.statement: The seller onboarding has four stages: Profile screening, Quality screening, Trial period, Full onboarding.

evidence.quote: Onboarding process slide: 1 Profile screening, 2 Quality screening, 3 Trial period, 4 Full onboarding

facts.statement: Quality screening: once the profile is validated, the seller gets access to the Fulfillment App.

evidence.quote: At this stage, as I mentioned, your profile has been validated and you will now get access to
Once your profile is validated, you will get access to the Fulfillment App

facts.statement: Quality screening step: the seller sends Revibe a first shipment of devices so Revibe can inspect quality. The seller creates the shipment in the Fulfillment App, selects products, and sets quantities and prices.

evidence.quote: The purpose of this is that you will send us a first batch of devices so that we
Create a shipment, select products products, set quantities and prices

facts.statement: Quality outcome: if quality is good on average, Revibe starts selling the devices and includes the seller in the payment cycle and onboarding. If quality does not match expectations, Revibe returns the devices and the seller is not onboarded.

evidence.quote: If the quality is good on average, we will immediately start selling your devices, include you in the
Unfortunately, if your quality doesn't match our expectations, we will return the devices to you.
Shipment to warehouse for inspection: check = Sales + Onboarding; X = Return + No-onboarding

facts.statement: Trial period (slide): only Fulfillment by Revibe during the trial period; the seller gets access to all Revibe tools and online trainings; the trial enables reaching significant volume and getting used to the Revibe environment.

evidence.quote: Trial period: Only Fulfillment by Revibe during trial period; You will get access to all Revibe tools and online trainings; It enables you to reach significant volume, get used to Revibe environment

facts.statement: Full onboarding (slide): once the seller reaches significant volume of orders, they are fully onboarded, direct shipping to customers is allowed, and there are no more limits. The slide gives no numeric volume threshold.

evidence.quote: Full onboarding: Once you have reached significant volume of orders you will be fully onboarded; It means direct shipping to customers will be allowed; No more limits !

facts.statement: Profile screening (slide): fill in the form in the app, input company information, input documents (TRN, trade license, Emirates ID), and get access to Revibe's main information (contract, quality guidelines).

terms.meaning: The Revibe app (on appsheet.com) where a seller sees the catalog, creates shipments and requests products. The profile link points to it. Shown as 'Revibe - Fulfillment App'.
The app where the seller's profile is filled in and where approval is shown (Profile list with Application status and Approval).
Stage 2 of onboarding: the first shipment of devices is sent to Revibe and inspected; good quality leads to sales and onboarding, otherwise the devices are returned (no onboarding).
Stage 3: only Fulfillment by Revibe during the trial period; access to all Revibe tools and online trainings (slide).
Stage 4: reached after significant volume of orders; direct shipping to customers allowed (slide).
The catalog reference for one product variant (model, storage, colour, condition), shown in the SKU column. Example: 010109-060101.
Per the narration, an estimate of how many pieces the seller could sell over the next 15 days. Shown per SKU.
Price set for a SKU. The trainer says 9,999 means no price has been set yet.
Field on the request products form, shown as 598 for the example SKU. The trainer calls it the current price. The error text says the seller's price must win by at least 1 AED.
The Requests Supplier Form. Only one can be open at a time (trainer). Each SKU in it is a request_products line.
A line in a shipment: one SKU with quantity sent and price. Created with New in the request_products section.
The number of pieces the seller sends for that SKU (example: 10).
Shown on the request line; the values match Quantity Sent x Price (example: 10 x 597 = 5,970). The video does not state the formula.
